NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: An old lavastone master offers to train a young villager: accept the training, or decline the cost.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has spent forty years learning to hold a lavastone without being overwhelmed. (subject.His/her) hands shake, (subject.his/her) back aches, and (subject.he/she) sleeps badly. But (subject.he/she) can heal a burn with a touch of the stone. (subject.He/she) has offered to train (friend), who has the steadiest hands in the village. (friend) has seen what it has cost (subject). What should (friend) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) accepts. The first lesson is not touching the stone at all: just breathing near it, for a month. The second is touching it for one heartbeat. (friend) faints. (subject) says that is excellent progress. It will take years. (friend) is already feeling the strain.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) thanks (subject) and declines. (subject) is disappointed, and also relieved. "Good," (subject.he/she) says. "Somebody should live an easy life." (friend) visits (subject) every week anyway, and rubs (subject.his/her) aching shoulders.
